source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Ships shall have means to ensure safe evacuation of persons, including safe deployment of survival equipment, when operating in ice-covered waters, or directly onto the ice, as applicable.

contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_operates_in_ice_covered_waters = true OR direct_evacuation_onto_ice_applicable = true, THEN safe_evacuation_means_present = true AND survival_equipment_deployment_approval_status = approved.
